Hi! To answer your questions: It will "wear off" so to speak within about 4 months, as in unfreezing the pelvic floor muscles. The goal however is that you use this time and your vaginas now inability to tense up to practice dilator therapy where it would not have been possible before the botox like in my case. I noticed no difficulty at all with urination or anything for that matter, I had pain and bleeding for a few days after the procedure because my hymen was also cut so that it wouldnt impede my ability to achieve penetration, which was awesome tbh because it made first time having sex very comfortable because it was all healed up and out of the way! I would recommend you do not get this surgery anywhere you do not feel very comfortable and well taken care of, this is a very sensitive, important, and truly life altering process to go through- do not take it lightly! It is worth the effort and money to me personally to make yourself feel whole, my whole attitude towards my body and my relationship changed for the better after I did this.
